title.zh: 卡尔纳克的托勒密三世门楼

alt.en: Ram sculptures line a sandy approach to a carved gateway, with several people standing in front.
alt.zh: 公羊雕像排列在沙土通道两侧，前方雕刻门楼下站着数人。

caption.en: Pascal Sébah photographed the surviving gateway of Ptolemy III at Karnak around 1875.
caption.zh: 帕斯卡尔·塞巴约于1875年拍摄卡尔纳克留存的托勒密三世门楼。

interpretation.en: Ram sculptures lead toward the carved gateway. Egyptian temple forms connect the dynasty to older religious institutions; the people and condition of the avenue belong to the much later photograph.
interpretation.zh: 公羊雕像把视线引向雕刻门楼。埃及神庙形式将王朝与更古老的宗教制度相连；画中人物与通道的保存状况，则属于很久之后的拍摄时刻。

title.zh: 延伸阅读：托勒密埃及：地中海王国

alt.en: William IV poses beneath drapery with a rolled document in his right hand and a star on his coat.
alt.zh: 威廉四世在帷幕后摆姿，右手持卷轴，外套佩有星章。

caption.en: An 1830 mezzotint of William IV holding a scroll identified by the catalogue as Magna Carta.
caption.zh: 1830年威廉四世美柔汀肖像版画；馆藏目录将其所持卷轴辨识为《大宪章》。

interpretation.en: A nineteenth-century king presents himself through a charter born of conflict with a medieval king. The document’s later symbolic authority becomes visible in the pose and scroll.
interpretation.zh: 十九世纪国王借一份源自贵族与中世纪国王冲突的宪章塑造形象。姿态与卷轴呈现了这份文书后来获得的象征权威。

title.zh: 延伸阅读：大宪章：围绕王权的协商
以“普拉西男爵”为名的克莱武

alt.en: A half-length portrait of Robert Clive bears a printed inscription naming him Baron of Plassey and commander of Company forces.
alt.zh: 罗伯特·克莱武半身像下的题字称他为普拉西男爵及公司军队统帅。

caption.en: An eighteenth-century print after Gainsborough, inscribed with Clive’s title “Baron of Plassey” and his Company offices. Its exact year is unrecorded.
caption.zh: 十八世纪依据庚斯博罗作品制作的版画，题记列克莱武“普拉西男爵”头衔及公司职务；具体年份未载。

interpretation.en: The inscription attaches the victory to one commander’s public identity. Compare that claim to status with the linked account of Indian soldiers, Mir Jafar and bankers.
interpretation.zh: 题记把胜利归入一位统帅的公共形象。可将这种地位宣示，与关联条目中印度士兵、米尔·贾法尔和银行家的作用对照。

title.en: Patronage and instruments in the Royal Society’s image
title.zh: 皇家学会图像中的赞助与仪器

alt.en: Brouncker and Bacon flank a bust of Charles II beneath a winged figure; books, globes and instruments fill the arches.
alt.zh: 布龙克与培根分列查理二世胸像两旁，上方有带翼人物，拱门内布满书籍、地球仪与仪器。

caption.en: Hollar’s 1667 allegory, after Evelyn, places Brouncker and Francis Bacon beside Charles II’s bust. Bacon had died before the Society’s foundation.
caption.zh: 霍拉尔1667年依据伊夫林设计的寓意图，将布龙克与弗朗西斯·培根置于查理二世胸像旁；培根在学会创立前已经去世。

interpretation.en: Books, globes and instruments surround royal authority. Their arrangement joins patronage, intellectual ancestry and practical investigation in a symbolic institutional portrait.
interpretation.zh: 书籍、地球仪与仪器围绕王权形象排列，将赞助、思想源流与实践研究组合成象征性的机构肖像。
